Class ConstraintListConverter

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.toolkit.elements.ConstraintListConverter
All Implemented Interfaces:
PropertyConverter<List<Constraint>>
public final class ConstraintListConverter extends Object implements PropertyConverter<List<Constraint>>
Converts a space-separated string of constraint tokens to a List<Constraint>.

Each token is delegated to ConstraintConverter for parsing. Returns Optional.empty() if any token fails to parse.

Example: "fill fill(2) 20" → [Constraint.fill(), Constraint.fill(2), Constraint.length(20)]
